title: The Mathieu group ${\sf M}_{12}$ vs ${\mathbf{SL_3(3)}}$ in characteristic 3
summary: We prove that the principal $3$-blocks of the Mathieu group ${\sf M_{12}}$ and the special linear group $\SL_3(3)$ are splendidly Rickard equivalent, and hence derived equivalent, by applying Rickard's theorem whose origin goes back to the second author. As a byproduct we answer to a question on the first Hochschild cohomology of the principal $3$-blocks above posed by W. Murphy.
